label: Full-Service Community Schools · October reimbursement
summary: A community schools partnership on reimbursement asks to be repaid for October. Eleven rows, mixing paid, unpaid and out-of-period costs.

terms.title: Payment method (specific condition)
terms.text: As a specific condition of this award under 2 CFR 200.208, the recipient is paid by reimbursement. Each payment request may include only allowable costs the recipient has already paid, supported by documentation available on request.

terms.title: Approved services
terms.text: The approved application includes school-based health services, mentoring, afterschool enrichment, family food assistance coordination at each partner school site, and outreach to inform families about community school services.

terms.title: Participant incentives
terms.text: Incentives or gift cards for participants are not included in the approved budget narrative. Adding them requires prior written approval.
